definitions.explanation: A mathematical or general relationship where two quantities increase or decrease at the same rate. Also used in a broader sense for things that correlate with each other.
Short for proportional representation, an electoral system where seats are allocated in proportion to votes received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Results come in proportion to effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Housing demand is increasing in proportion to population growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{幸福度|こうふくど}→幸福度：20711_koufukudo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧しも{比例|ひれい}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Income and happiness are not necessarily proportional.

examples.japanese: {比例|ひれい}{代表|だいひょう}{制|せい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小|しょう}さな⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{議席|ぎせき}→議席：15176_giseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}→得る：02014_eru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Under the proportional representation system, even small parties can easily win seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{小選挙区|しょうせんきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In the election, one can run as a candidate in both proportional representation and single-seat districts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{議席|ぎせき}→議席：15176_giseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In this election, they won three seats through proportional representation.

notes:
USAGE:
In the general sense, commonly used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ (in proportion to). As a suru verb, it means "to be proportional." In the political sense, it is short for {比例|ひれい}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (proportional representation) and is very common in election coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比例|ひれい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧: in proportion to X
- {正|せい}{比例|ひれい}: direct proportion
- ⟦{反比例|はんぴれい}→反比例：18558_hanpirei⟧: inverse proportion
- {比例|ひれい}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: proportional representation
- {比例|ひれい}{区|く}: proportional representation block
